events.name: Bash
events.head: Render live Worker onboarding and check content

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep Worker JS bundle for new strings
events.input: $ cd /tmp; U=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; curl -s "$U/onboarding/?v=t191d" -o ob.html; grep -oE '/_next/static/[^"]+\.js' ob.html | sort -u > chunks.txt; wc -l < chunks.txt; for c in $(cat chunks.txt); do curl -s "$U$c"; done > allchunks.js; for s in "Make the 8 Decisions Every Page" "Offer, Buyer and Channels" "Watch the welcome" 'show:"welcome"' "links.welcome" "5 to 6"; do printf "%s: " "$s"; grep -c -- "$s" allchunks.js; done

events.head: Inspect onboarding HTML asset refs
events.input: $ cd /tmp; grep -oE '(src|href)="[^"]+"' ob.html | head -15; wc -c ob.html

events.input: $ cd /tmp; curl -sL -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/onboarding/?v=t191d" -o ob.html -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n"; wc -c ob.html; grep -oE '(src)="[^"]+\.js"' ob.html | head -5
